_comment: Synthetic demo data for Applicable.ai. Every company is fictional. Eligibility is never stored here: the canonical engine (oi.intelligence.eligibility) decides it; core/eligibility.py only maps `profile`, the user's answers and each role's `requirements` onto it. Each role's `start` ("2027-09") is a synthetic scenario field, not a real posting's start date: it exists only so the degree-in-progress rule (completion before role start) is deterministic. `sponsorship` is explicit: offered, not_offered or not_stated; only not_offered can conflict. Both `start` and `sponsorship` are synthetic scenario values, set deliberately for deterministic demo evaluation only; they are not real HR posting data. Sponsorship scenario: the London non-sponsors (Replai, Lazarde) do not offer it; Deutsch Bank Shanghai requires a permit already held (see its posting quote), so it does not offer it; the other UK and Singapore roles offer it; Roshe Shanghai, Milan, Basel and Frankfurt do not state it. Roshe Shanghai's `cn_permit` is unused legacy data kept for a later cleanup; it is not read as sponsorship. Factor scores stand in for the pipeline's output; the priority score is always computed by core/ranking.py. Roles `oi50-*` are derived from the OI-50 synthetic catalogue (`source_job_id`): company, title, city, country and any explicit deadline come from the catalogue; student status, degree level, graduation window, field and sponsorship come only from the committed parameter layer (config/eligibility/job_parameters.json); language levels are the posting's own words, so non-CEFR levels stay informational. Their other hard requirements are not parameterized and are not represented. Where the posting states no deadline, `closes` is a demo closing date (the urgency note says so). Their factor scores are demo fixtures from fixed rules: profile by role family (minus 8 when a stated language is not in the profile), preference 30 + 30 preferred city + 15 product/strategy/growth family + 10 hybrid, urgency 95 - 2 x days to close (10-95), freshness 50 (no source publication date).
